purpose: Preserve V174's certified shortest-request targeting while removing the one-function serialization barrier for a selected near-complete fork/join workflow by admitting its complete current heavy-terminal sibling cohort.

paper_sequence_gate.homogeneous_middle_and_high_historical_b: retain unchanged and do not rerun

causal_diagnosis.supported: V174 improved both selected-six aggregates relative to V173, so shortest current request remaining work is a supported completion-proximity key. However, its active mechanism admitted exactly one heavy terminal function per active window. In a fork/join DAG, choosing the correct near-complete request but admitting only one of its simultaneously eligible required terminal siblings can consume speculative capacity while still preventing workflow completion. The causal unit should therefore be one selected request cohort rather than one selected function.

single_mechanism_change_from_v174.activation_rule: unchanged: active exactly when current heavy incomplete-parent terminal player count is strictly greater than two
single_mechanism_change_from_v174.inactive_rule: unchanged exact V159 terminal admission for zero, one or two heavy players
single_mechanism_change_from_v174.selected_request_order: ascending current_request_remaining_work, then minimum immutable CPU work among that request's current heavy terminal candidates, then request_id
single_mechanism_change_from_v174.selected_player_definition: every unique current collectable heavy incomplete-parent terminal request-function player whose request_id equals the selected request_id
single_mechanism_change_from_v174.within_selected_request_order: ascending immutable function CPU work then function_id
single_mechanism_change_from_v174.excess_rule: unchanged exact V168 closed CPU-guard rejection for heavy terminal players belonging to every nonselected request
